verdict.rationale: Metorial documents a public REST API with publishable and secret API keys, serves an OpenAPI spec, and indexes an API reference in llms.txt. A runtime probe confirmed the API at api.metorial.com is live and Bearer-key-gated, returning machine-readable errors exactly as documented. Official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs sit on top of it. missing for 10: endpoint-level reference content in the pack (only key setup and the OpenAPI file's existence are shown), independent community reports of driving the REST API directly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can generate both publishable and secret API keys in your Metorial dashboard by navigating to Developer → API Keys and clicking Create API Key.
the documented public REST API is live and key-gated exactly as the docs describe
Metorial gives developers official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs to connect AI agents to tools in minutes.
